1. **F1 — blocking, issue-impact (high):** `watch_startup` checks for exit before the readiness probe, then returns `Serving` immediately when the probe reads an HTTP prefix ([serve.rs:434](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/serve.rs:434)). A child can send that response and exit before the parent finishes the read; the caller then writes its PID without another exit check ([serve.rs:607](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/serve.rs:607), [serve.rs:633](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/serve.rs:633)). This still publishes a stale PID file for a child that exited during startup, violating REQ-01 and REQ-02. The success test only injects readiness for a sleeping child, so it cannot expose this response-then-exit path. Recheck/reap the child after a successful readiness probe before publishing the PID, with a deterministic response-then-exit test. References: `@/issue/400a8539/requirement/REQ-01`, `@/issue/400a8539/requirement/REQ-02`.
